name: Cait Sith, Fortune Teller — target creature gets +X/+0, X = the exiled card's mana value, entered on the trigger
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). A number read off a card that is not on the battlefield is asked for as X on the fired ability (the "where X is …" clause is cut from the fired text and the ability gets an X input, saved with the board). "When you exile a card this way, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that card's mana value." parsed to nothing. X = 4: Grizzly Bears 6/2.
